options.content: ● nothing to report  ● needs attention  ● alarm  ● data problem  ·  bar: % of design (white line = 100 %)  ·  trend: daily output, last 30 days (dashed = design)  ·  within limits: days within all limits ÷ days sampled (green ≥ 95 %, amber 80–95 %, red < 80 %)

panels.description: Statistics-table sites (AHSPA, NTIEM, Nanded) and sensor sites (Zim Lab, Riverview 1500 and 2000) on one page. Riverview volumes from the flow meters; Riverview 1500 days with less than 80 % of readings are left out. Zim Lab energy is per m³ of inlet and is excluded from the energy average.

targets.rawSql:
WITH today AS (SELECT (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date AS d),
st AS (SELECT 'AHSPA' AS name, "Date" AS day, daily_flow_out AS v, daily_power AS kwh, 100 * (daily_cod_avg_inlet - daily_cod_avg_outlet) / NULLIF(daily_cod_avg_inlet, 0) AS k, NULL::numeric AS tss FROM gsi_ahspa_stats WHERE "Date" >= (SELECT d FROM today) - 30 AND "Date" < (SELECT d FROM today)
 UNION ALL SELECT 'NTIEM', "Date", daily_flow_out, daily_power_total, 100 * (daily_avg_inlet_cod - daily_avg_outlet_cod) / NULLIF(daily_avg_inlet_cod, 0), NULL FROM gsi_ntiem_stats WHERE "Date" >= (SELECT d FROM today) - 30 AND "Date" < (SELECT d FROM today)
 UNION ALL SELECT 'Nanded MBR', "Date", daily_permeate_flow, daily_power, daily_avg_outlet_cod, daily_avg_outlet_tss FROM gsi_nandedmbr_stats WHERE "Date" >= (SELECT d FROM today) - 30 AND "Date" < (SELECT d FROM today)),
meta(name, grp, des, key_lbl, key_unit, ord, cetp) AS (VALUES ('AHSPA','CETP · 30,000 m³/d',30000,'COD reduction','%',2,true),('NTIEM','CETP · 100,000 m³/d',100000,'COD reduction','%',3,true),('Nanded MBR','MBR · 7,500 m³/d',7500,'Treated COD','mg/L',4,false)),
lab AS (SELECT CASE f.team_id WHEN 219 THEN 'AHSPA' ELSE 'NTIEM' END AS name, (l.time_of_sample_collection AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date AS day, btrim(l.type_of_lab_test) AS t, avg(l.result) AS v FROM user_labtestdata l JOIN user_customform f ON f.id = l.form_id WHERE ((f.team_id = 219 AND btrim(l.location) = 'CETP Outfall') OR (f.team_id = 25 AND btrim(l.location) = 'Outlet')) AND l.time_of_sample_collection > now() - interval '31 days' AND l.time_of_sample_collection < now() GROUP BY 1, 2, 3),
lim(name, t, w, a, lo, hi) AS (VALUES ('AHSPA','COD',220,250,NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric),('AHSPA','TSS',75,100,NULL,NULL),('AHSPA','TAN',5,10,NULL,NULL),('AHSPA','pH',NULL,NULL,6.5,8.5),('NTIEM','COD',225,250,NULL,NULL),('NTIEM','TSS',80,100,NULL,NULL),('NTIEM','TAN',40,50,NULL,NULL),('NTIEM','pH',NULL,NULL,6.5,8.5)),
lj AS (SELECT lab.name, lab.day, lab.t, ((lim.lo IS NOT NULL AND (lab.v < lim.lo OR lab.v > lim.hi)) OR (lim.w IS NOT NULL AND lab.v >= lim.w)) AS out, ((lim.lo IS NOT NULL AND (lab.v < lim.lo OR lab.v > lim.hi)) OR (lim.a IS NOT NULL AND lab.v >= lim.a)) AS alarm FROM lab JOIN lim ON lim.name = lab.name AND lim.t = lab.t),
ld AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (name, t) name, t, alarm FROM lj ORDER BY name, t, day DESC),
s AS (SELECT m.*, (SELECT max(day) FROM st WHERE st.name = m.name AND st.v > 0) AS up_to,
  (SELECT avg(v) FROM st WHERE st.name = m.name AND st.v > 0) AS flow30,
  (SELECT v FROM st WHERE st.name = m.name AND st.v > 0 ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 1) / m.des * 100 AS pct,
  (SELECT string_agg(COALESCE(round(st.v)::text, ''), ',' ORDER BY g.day) FROM generate_series((SELECT d FROM today) - 30, (SELECT d FROM today) - 1, interval '1 day') g(day) LEFT JOIN st ON st.name = m.name AND st.day = g.day::date AND st.v > 0) AS series,
  (SELECT sum(kwh) FROM st WHERE st.name = m.name AND st.v > 0 AND st.kwh > 0) AS kwh30, (SELECT sum(v) FROM st WHERE st.name = m.name AND st.v > 0 AND st.kwh > 0) AS m3_30,
  (SELECT avg(k) FROM st WHERE st.name = m.name AND k > 0) AS key_val,
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT day) FROM lj WHERE lj.name = m.name) AS score_n,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT day FROM lj WHERE lj.name = m.name GROUP BY day HAVING NOT bool_or(out)) x) AS score_ok,
  (SELECT bool_or(alarm) FROM ld WHERE ld.name = m.name) AS alarm_now,
  (SELECT max(c) FROM (SELECT count(*) AS c FROM lj WHERE lj.name = m.name AND lj.day > (SELECT d FROM today) - 7 AND out GROUP BY t) x) AS out7,
  (SELECT count(tss) >= 7 AND count(DISTINCT tss) = 1 FROM st WHERE st.name = m.name) AS tss_const
 FROM meta m)
SELECT name, grp, des, ord, to_char(up_to, 'DD Mon') AS up_to, (SELECT d FROM today) - 1 - up_to AS behind, flow30, pct, series, kwh30, m3_30, key_lbl, key_unit, key_val,
 CASE WHEN NOT cetp THEN 'none' WHEN key_val >= 80 THEN 'ok' WHEN key_val >= 60 THEN 'amber' ELSE 'red' END AS key_col,
 CASE WHEN cetp THEN score_ok END AS score_ok, CASE WHEN cetp THEN score_n END AS score_n,
 CASE WHEN alarm_now OR (cetp AND key_val < 60) THEN 'red'
      WHEN up_to IS NULL OR (SELECT d FROM today) - 1 - up_to > 3 OR tss_const THEN 'purple'
      WHEN (SELECT d FROM today) - 1 - up_to > 1 OR flow30 > des OR (cetp AND key_val < 80) OR COALESCE(out7, 0) >= 3 THEN 'amber' ELSE 'ok' END AS sev
FROM s ORDER BY ord

targets.query: SELECT m3, kwh, n FROM (SELECT sum(v) / 2 AS m3, last(e) - first(e) AS kwh, count(v) AS n FROM (SELECT mean("202_fit_03_mbr_permeate_flow") AS v, last("900_mfm_01_mcc_main_energy_total") AS e FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 32d GROUP BY time(30m) fill(none)) WHERE time > now() - 32d GROUP BY time(1d, 18h30m) fill(none))

SELECT m3, kwh, n FROM (SELECT sum(v) / 2 AS m3, last(e) - first(e) AS kwh, count(v) AS n FROM (SELECT mean("202_fit_03_suf_permeate_flow") AS v, last("900_mfm_01_mcc_main_energy_total") AS e FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 32d GROUP BY time(30m) fill(none)) WHERE time > now() - 32d GROUP BY time(1d, 18h30m) fill(none))

SELECT last("100_fit_01_inlet_flow_totalizer") - first("100_fit_01_inlet_flow_totalizer") AS m3, last("900_mfm_01_mcc_main_energy_total") - first("900_mfm_01_mcc_main_energy_total") AS kwh, 100 * (last("302_fit_02_ro_permeate_flow_totalizer") - first("302_fit_02_ro_permeate_flow_totalizer")) / ((last("302_fit_02_ro_permeate_flow_totalizer") - first("302_fit_02_ro_permeate_flow_totalizer")) + (last("302_fit_01_ro_reject_flow_totalizer") - first("302_fit_01_ro_reject_flow_totalizer"))) AS rec FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 32d AND "100_fit_01_inlet_flow_totalizer" > 0 AND "302_fit_02_ro_permeate_flow_totalizer" > 0 AND "302_fit_01_ro_reject_flow_totalizer" > 0 GROUP BY time(1d, 18h30m) fill(none)
SELECT count(v) AS n24 FROM (SELECT mean("202_fit_03_mbr_permeate_flow") AS v FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 24h GROUP BY time(10m) fill(none))
SELECT last("202_fit_03_mbr_permeate_flow") AS l FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 7d
SELECT last("202_fit_03_suf_permeate_flow") AS l FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 7d
SELECT count(v) AS n24 FROM (SELECT mean("100_fit_01_inlet_flow_totalizer") AS v FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 24h GROUP BY time(10m) fill(none))
SELECT last("100_fit_01_inlet_flow_totalizer") AS l FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 7d
SELECT spread("302_ait_01_ro_combined_permeate_ph") AS sp, last("302_ait_01_ro_combined_permeate_ph") AS l FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 30d

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE f.team_id WHEN 191 THEN 'Riverview 1500' ELSE 'Riverview 2000' END AS name, avg(l.result) AS v FROM user_labtestdata l JOIN user_customform f ON f.id = l.form_id WHERE ((f.team_id = 191 AND btrim(l.location) = 'Treated Wastewater' AND btrim(l.type_of_lab_test) = 'COD') OR (f.team_id = 189 AND btrim(l.location) = 'Treated Water' AND btrim(l.type_of_lab_test) = 'TDS')) AND l.time_of_sample_collection > now() - interval '31 days' AND l.time_of_sample_collection < now() GROUP BY 1

options.content: Dot = most severe rule: outlet value above alarm on the latest sample or COD reduction below 60 % (red); no data, data more than 3 days behind, feed silent for 12 h, or a value constant / impossible for 30 days (purple); data 2–3 days behind, above design, key target missed, an outlet value above warning on 3+ of the last 7 days, or under 90 % of readings in the last 24 h (amber).
